elements.name: young passenger seen from behind with turned head at edge of frame

wrong_setting: The reference-sheet poses have been painted into the window as two copies of the character standing on the sill, so the view reads as people outside or on the window rather than a landscape seen from a bus. The forest of fir trees looks more alpine than Ethiopian highland.
anatomy: Two duplicated full-figure versions of the character stand impossibly on the window ledge. The foreground passenger's backpack straps and the seat blend together. A partial extra figure is cropped at the left edge.
notes: Remove the two standing figures copied from the reference sheet in the window and the stray left-edge passenger. Make the seated passenger match the sheet: slim Ethiopian young man, short black hair, plain dark jacket over a light shirt, backpack resting on his knees rather than worn on his shoulders.
